notes.title: 1.0.3 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]1.0.3 Patch Notes[/b]

Changes:

- Starting a new game with the speedrun timer enabled skips opening cutscene (doesn’t affect final speedrun times).
- Luna makes less comments during the PADDLE match and several are only triggered at special events (e.g. after not being able to score a single point in 3 consecutive rounds).
- Can use the Esc key to close pause menu menu.

Bugfixes:

- Fixed spelling mistakes.
- Rank error in speedrun message when user didn’t get a PB.
- Look circle not disappearing after viewing drawing/Speedrun info.

notes.title: One Dreamer: Prologue Release Date
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37397649/e29a3765390f42d5d73c423c129f788b875b7298.png[/img]

Hi everyone, 

One Dreamer: Prologue will be released on the 7th of May, 2020. The game will be available on Windows and macOS at launch with planned support for Linux shortly after.

The prologue provides a backstory to several main characters while showcasing the gameplay, voice acting and coding puzzles you will experience in One Dreamer. However, it isn’t necessarily chapter one and can be played as a short, conclusive story on its own.

Thank you for all your support,
Gareth

For more frequent updates follow the game on twitter:
[url=https://twitter.com/OneDreamerGame]@OneDreamerGame[/url]
